COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
18.10.2022 SPA No. 340 of 2022 
Hon'ble Vipin Sanghi, C.J. 
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel for the 
appellants. 
 Ms. Puja Banga, learned Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand / respondent Nos. 1 to 5. 
 Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel for 
respondent No. 6. 
 Since there is a dispute whether or not the 
land of the appellants falling in Khata No. 26 of 
Village Bagi is in occupation of respondent No. 6, 
we direct the Tehsildar concerned to make an on￾spot inspection after identifying the land falling in 
Khata No. 26 and reporting as to who is in 
occupation of the said land. It should specifically 
be stated whether respondent No. 6, i.e. THDC or 
anybody claiming through THDC is in occupation of 
the said land. The inspection should be conducted 
on 02.11.2022 at 11:00 AM. 
 The parties shall remain present during the 
inspection and shall participate in the proceedings. 
The Inspection Report shall be prepared and signed  on the spot. They shall also be free to record 
observation or objection, if any. 
 The Tehsildar shall take assistance of other 
Experts for the purpose of identification and 
measurement of the land falling in Khata No. 26. 
 Let the report be sent to this Court before the 
next date. 
 List on 21.11.2022. 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J) (Vipin Sanghi, CJ) 
 18.10.2022 18.10.2022 
Rathour

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Vipin Sanghi,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND 
AT NAINITAL 
SRI JUSTICE VIPIN SANGHI, C.J. 
AND 
SRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J. 
17TH APRIL, 2023 
SPECIAL APPEAL NO. 340 OF 2022 
Between: 
Mahipal Singh Negi and others. …….Appellants 
and 
State of Uttarakhand and others. .…Respondents 
Counsel for the appellants : Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel. 
Counsel for the respondent Nos. 1 
to 5. 
: Mr. Vikas Pandey, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
 
Counsel for the THDC : Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel. 
 
Upon hearing the learned Counsel, the Court made the 
following 
ORDER: (per Sri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.) 
 The report has been filed by the Tehsildar, as per 
which the land in Khata No. 26 comprising of Khasra Nos. 
897, 901, 903, 904, 911, 912, 913, 917, 920, 922 and 930 
is recorded in the name of respondent-THDC India Private 
Limited. At the same time, the THDC India Private Limited 
is not in possession and even the appellants were not found 
in possession at the site. Upon inspection, it was found that 
the THDC India Private Limited has not undertaken any 
activities on the land, and the THDC India Private Limited 
has also not dealt with the land.  2 
2. The appellants are claiming compensation on the 
ground that the land was acquired for the purpose of THDC 
India Private Limited. Though the appellants have placed on 
record the Notification issued under Section 4, read with 
Section 17, of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the appellants 
have not placed on record any documents as regards the 
acquisition proceedings. 
3. Learned counsel for the appellants seeks time to 
produce certain documents in that regard. 
4. At his request, list on 12.09.2023. 
5. The appellants may file a Supplementary Affidavit 
within six weeks. 
________________ 
VIPIN SANGHI, C.J. 
___________________ 
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J. 
Dt: 17th April, 2023 
Rathour
